svg.title: Public repository constellation — orbital activity
svg.desc: 26 public repositories. One orbiting satellite per repo; rings indicate original repositories, moons indicate forks, and marker count encodes authored commits on the default branch. Colors show curated project categories: research, graphics, coursework, notes, and other. More recent pushes have smaller orbital radii, measured at the saved snapshot. The three most recently pushed repositories stay named in a separate ledger. Snapshot 2026-11-21. Reduced motion shows fixed satellite positions.
